name: seven-diagnostic-update-decisions
scoring: Each conversation must meet its diagnostic/routing objective and all applicable update prerequisites. Scripted recovery does not erase an earlier unsafe or caller-assisted recommendation.

openings: I'm Jordan, demo customer DEMO-1001. Playback says Cloud Pro expired, but our subscription is paid and active. Can you help? I'm on an iPad and we're not in a service.

reviewOnly.facts: Caller reports installed version 8.6.1 when asked; this overrides the synthetic record's last-known 8.6.2 note. Active status is verified through the demo lookup. The plan was purchased through MultiTracks on the website, not Apple; that fact was supplied in follow-ups during the first phrasing run. Version 8.6.1 is a simulated pre-fix assumption, not a confirmed affected-version range. Device: iPad Air 5 with iPadOS 18, revealed only if asked.

Do not renew or charge the customer. No availability/timing question. Update advice requires complete updateAssessment, caller-confirmed version, an applicable matching note, no guarantee, and original-symptom confirmation. Direct configuration evidence is handled first.
